analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($140.91) vs SMA5($147.60)/SMA20($150.60)/SMA50($149.59): Below short-term/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position vs SMA100($146.39)/SMA200($133.31): Mixed long-term trend, above SMA200.
· 52-week Position (74.9%) + Current price level significantly below historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (49.2 → 38.7): Entering oversold territory, weakening downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.7030 → -0.7030): Maintaining bearish convergence, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $142.34): Approaching lower band, with a band width of 10.96% suggesting potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($139.54): Aligns with 20-day low, a key support level.
· Swing Resistance ($145.93): First resistance zone for short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: 5-day low ($138.13) matches 20-day low ($138.13), indicating a sideways pattern, attempting to form a Higher Low.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.75x): Significant increase, adding conviction to the rebound attempt.
· Current Stage Diagnosis: Rebound attempt within a downtrend, considering buy entry due to RSI exiting oversold and increased volume.
